# Oneiron — Memory Wire

> Actor-bound memory for agents. Start with vault.witness, vault.recall and vault.receipts.
> The mirror below is full fidelity, generated from shipped SDK sources. CI publishes the generated
> files (types, facade types, verb census) at https://oneiron-dev.github.io/oneiron/agent-sdk/ from main;
> a cargo build keeps a local copy in target/debug/sdk-generated/agent-sdk/.

## Memory Wire SDK

- [Complete quickstarts and API](docs/agent-sdk/quickstart.md): JS/Python, embedded/remote, complete imports and typed errors.
- [Type declarations](https://oneiron-dev.github.io/oneiron/agent-sdk/types.md): full TypeScript DTOs and Python stubs.
- [Facade types](https://oneiron-dev.github.io/oneiron/agent-sdk/facade-types.md): generated verb wire types.
- [Error catalogue](docs/agent-sdk/errors.md): stable codes, suggestions and remediation.
- [Verb census](https://oneiron-dev.github.io/oneiron/agent-sdk/verbs.md): authoritative shipped facade and stable names.
- [Vercel AI SDK tools](packages/oneiron-ai-sdk/README.md): thin three-verb satellite and runnable agent sample.
- [LangGraph BaseStore](packages/oneiron-langgraph/README.md): exact actor-owned long-term keyed memory, not checkpoints.
- [HTTP API](oneiron.skills.md): endpoint activation index, endpoint details and error schemas.
